'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Olson LS Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core|Ref3-L-nabootheedpalacegeneratorcore.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' It's A Kyle/MikeFrench Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
